verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.gladia.io with a product summary and an index of documentation entries. Doc pages are also served as markdown (.md) and point agents to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be directed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and an OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) to complement them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.gladia.io/llms.txt # Gladia
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.gladia.io/llms.txt
